title: Your comfort zone will keep you safe…
paragraphs:
Your comfort zone will keep you safe…
but your calling will make you STRONG.
When God is pulling you forward, staying where you are is no longer an option.
Step out. Step up. Step into what Heaven has written for you.
Your breakthrough is always on the OTHER SIDE of obedience. ✨🔥
“Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged, for the Lord your God will be with you wherever you go.” — Joshua 1:9 (NIV)
